scrimColor.$description: Black scrim behind the site header; gradient stops remain component-owned.

surface.$description: Translucent secondary surface behind real project-card media.

hoverOverlay.$description: Warm translucent overlay revealed over project-card media on hover.

surface.$description: Inset near-black surface used by repeated case-study modules.

border.$description: Subtle white boundary around repeated case-study modules.

divider.$description: Quieter white divider between sections inside case-study modules.

accentViolet.$description: Violet step of the module accent rotation used to differentiate grid categories.

accentEmerald.$description: Emerald step of the module accent rotation used to differentiate grid categories.

accentSlate.$description: Slate step of the module accent rotation used to differentiate grid categories.

flash.$description: Warm peak color used during a project-section arrival flash.

backdrop.$description: Near-opaque black backdrop behind expanded case-study images.

awardDot.$description: Amber marker identifying award events on the about timeline.

educationDot.$description: Blue marker identifying education events on the about timeline.

paper.$description: White paper the resume is set on, on screen and in the printed PDF.

ink.$description: Primary ink on the resume paper: name, entry titles, skill labels.

inkSecondary.$description: Running text on the resume paper: summaries and bullets, at the site's secondary tier.

inkTertiary.$description: Dates, locations, and contact lines on the resume paper.

accent.$description: Section headings and the title line, the resume's one accent.

rule.$description: Hairline under each resume section heading.
